name: 94618 · Oakland, CA
findings: ZIP 94618 (Oakland) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94618 (Oakland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94618 (Oakland) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
